verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a Subscriptions API for creating subscriptions without the Dashboard, and its proration docs imply programmatic subscription changes; webhooks cover status transitions. The pack has no explicit evidence of pause or cancel endpoints, so only part of the lifecycle is documented here. Missing for 10: documented API pause and cancel operations, explicit update-subscription endpoint docs, hands-on corroboration of full API-only lifecycle management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, pause, and cancel subscriptions through a documented API — the full lifecycle without touching a dashboard

citations.quote: Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
You can preview a proration to view the amount before applying the changes.
You can use webhook events to monitor and handle transitions between statuses.
Use the Trial Offer API to manage both free and paid introductory periods for your subscriptions with a single API integration.
